newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian envoy leaves to see Netanyahu, Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian envoy leaves to see Netanyahu, Arafat.

text.p: Egyptian mediator Osama el-Baz left Cairo on Thursday on a mission to arrange another round of direct peace negotiations between Israel and the Palestinians.

Cairo airport sources said Baz, senior political adviser to Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, was on his way to separate meetings with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem and with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
Those contacts will show whether a second round of direct talks can take place this week under Egyptian auspices.
Israelis and Palestinians met in Cairo last Sunday for the first substantive talks since Israel decided in March to go ahead with a Jewish housing project in Arab East Jerusalem.

The Egyptian mediator and Israeli officials said at the end of the talks that some progress had been made and that the two sides planned to meet again. But a Palestinian official was not so positive on what the talks had achieved.
